messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: SEV-2: enterprise-gateway/vpc-streaming - websocket timeouts observed for tenant T-ACME (streaming sessions failing, 50% error rate). Auto-page to eng-sre and oncall.

ben (oncall): saw the page, I'm on it. grabbing logs now. @sara can you join?

sara (eng-sre): joining. initial glance — client-side retries spiking, connections dropped with ECONNRESET from our gateway. CX reports degraded live transcription for AcmeCorp.

kevin (support): customer-facing note: Acme support says it started ~09:12 UTC, they see reconnect storms client-side. They're on a call with us.

olivia (eng-runtime): past hour we rolled a kernel selection change to the dedicated pool for acct T-ACME at 08:55 UTC. Might be related. Rolling back is an option but need safe rollback path.

ben (oncall): can we isolate? if it's pool-level, isolate tenant traffic to another healthy pool and disable streaming on the affected host group temporarily.

olivia (eng-runtime): I can route T-ACME to fallback pool (dedicated-pool-3) via routing policy change. That will create brief auth handshake spikes but should stop ECONNRESET. Doing canary 5% first.

sara (eng-sre): while routing change happens, let's also adjust websocket keepalive from 30s -> 10s for the gateway to reduce long-lived stale connections. Config update below:
```yaml
gateway:
  websocket:
    keepalive_seconds: 10
    max_inflight_streams: 200
```

deploy-bot: deploy started: gateway-config/2026-03-15-keepalive. Can run in staging -> prod via hot-config.

ben (oncall): I'm going to escalate to platform infra to confirm pool health metrics before 100% cutover. @olivia keep the canary at 5% until we confirm.

olivia (eng-runtime): canary at 5% live. Dropping sessions to fallback pool now: `route update --tenant T-ACME --to dedicated-pool-3 --weight 5%`

sara (eng-sre): noticing reduced ECONNRESET rate on canary traces. Client retry counts for canary sessions down ~60%. Good sign.

kevin (support): told Acme contact: "We see a partial mitigation. We're routing a small percentage of your traffic to a healthy pool and adjusting gateway keepalive. We'll update every 10m." They appreciate the transparency but asked for ETA.

megan (solutions): prepping customer-facing rollback notes and an incident summary for the account exec. Also verifying any config they manage that could be causing retry storms.

olivia (eng-runtime): quick note — the kernel selection change toggled a new epoll batching mode on the affected hosts. If rollback needed the command is:
```bash
runtime-ctl set-kernel-selection dedicated-pool-2 --mode=compat
```
but that requires draining existing sessions.

ben (oncall): we should avoid full rollback while canary trending positive. Plan: monitor 15m; if errors drop <5% baseline, ramp to 100% and keep kernel change disabled on new hosts.

sara (eng-sre): agree. Also creating a temporary per-tenant connection limiter to prevent client retry amplification: `conn_limit: 300` for T-ACME.

olivia (eng-runtime): applied conn_limit=300 for tenant via runtime feature flag.

deploy-bot: config change applied to dedicated-pool-3 and gateway edge nodes.

ben (oncall): metrics update at +10m: error-rate for the tenant decreased from 50% -> 12% on the canary group. Overall traffic error-rate now 18%. Keep ramp plan in place.

kevin (support): Acme insists on root cause and wants to know whether this was our config change. They're asking for exact timestamps. Passing: can we confirm if kernel selection rollout at 08:55 was targeted only to dedicated-pool-2?

olivia (eng-runtime): confirmed: rollout targeted dedicated-pool-2 hosts only. The canary pool dedicated-pool-3 was untouched. That lines up with symptom onset.

megan (solutions): ETA request update to Acme: preliminary mitigation in place; full cutover expected in ~25min pending metrics. We'll prepare RCA draft once final state is stable.

ben (oncall): ramping to 30% now. Command: `route update --tenant T-ACME --to dedicated-pool-3 --weight 30%`

sara (eng-sre): also flagged potential client behavior: their client retries are eager (retry backoff short). Recommend we ask Acme to patch client to use exponential backoff and jitter while we stabilize. Sending sample snippet.
```js
// suggested client backoff
const backoff = (attempt) => Math.min(1000 * 2**attempt + Math.random()*200, 30000);
```

ben (oncall): at +25m: error-rate now ~6% overall, failures mostly affecting older long-lived sessions that didn't get reconnected. New sessions healthy.

olivia (eng-runtime): given trend, planning 100% cutover in 5m. Will schedule a short connection drain window (60s) to avoid double-handshake.

kevin (support): letting Acme know cutover timeline and asking them to keep client team on standby for quick client-side patch if needed.

deploy-bot: route update completed: weight=100% to dedicated-pool-3 for tenant T-ACME. Drain completed.

ben (oncall): confirming final checks — CPU/mem on dedicated-pool-3 stable, no error spike. Marking mitigation as successful.

sara (eng-sre): next steps: 1) keep conn_limit and keepalive change for 24h, 2) roll back kernel selection change on dedicated-pool-2 once traffic stable, 3) prepare RCA and customer timeline. Assigning owners: olivia -> rollback plan, megan -> customer comms, sara -> incident postmortem.

megan (solutions): noted. drafting customer update now and will send to AE for review.

olivia (eng-runtime): scheduling rollback window for dedicated-pool-2 at 03:00 UTC to `compat` mode with controlled drain. Will post notify.

ben (oncall): downgrading page severity to SEV-4 (mitigated, customer impacted but stable). Logging incident end state.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: SEV-4 - mitigated. Actions recorded in incident ticket #INC-2026-298.

kevin (support): closing out customer-facing update: sent note with current state, mitigation steps, and ETA for RCA. Customer responded :thumbsup:.

sara (eng-sre): creating postmortem doc and will include timelines, config diff, and a short checklist to avoid future client amplification (client backoff guidance + auto per-tenant conn limits).

ben (oncall): handing off to day triage. I'm going offline for 2 hours. Thanks team.

megan (solutions): adding AE and account owner to follow up.

olivia (eng-runtime): leaving runbook link and commands in the incident ticket.

incident-bot: THREAD CLOSED: last update 1990309050.
